Based on AI-mapped estimates, this is approximately 53% of the total buildings.The average age of data for this region is 2 years ( Last edited 4 months ago ) and 5% buildings were added or updated in the last 6 months. lineage.description: Building polygon geometries were extracted from the OpenStreetMap database for Spain using the Humanitarian OpenStreetMap Team (HOT) Raw Data API. The dataset represents volunteered geographic information contributed by OSM mappers, supplemented by AI-mapped building estimates to assess coverage completeness. The resulting spatial inventory provides a national-scale building footprint dataset suitable for exposure analysis in disaster risk assessments.
